faq.howToCreateAccount: How do I create an account?
faq.howToCreateAccountAnswer: Tap 'Sign Up' on the login screen, fill in your username, email, phone number, and password. Your account will be created instantly!
faq.howToListProperty: How do I list a property?
faq.howToListPropertyAnswer: Go to the 'Add Property' tab, fill in the property details including photos, price, location, and amenities. Your listing will be reviewed and published within 24 hours.
faq.howToSearchProperty: How do I search for properties?
faq.howToSearchPropertyAnswer: Use the 'Explore' tab to browse all properties. You can filter by price, location, property type, bedrooms, and more to find your perfect match.
faq.howToChangePassword: How do I change my password?
faq.howToChangePasswordAnswer: Go to Profile → Edit Profile → Change Password. Enter your current password and your new password to update it.
faq.howToEnable2FA: How do I enable two-factor authentication?
faq.howToEnable2FAAnswer: Go to Profile → Security → Enable Two-Factor Authentication. You'll receive a verification code via email each time you log in for added security.
faq.howToDeleteAccount: How do I delete my account?
faq.howToDeleteAccountAnswer: Go to Profile → Edit Profile → Delete Account. Warning: This action is permanent and will delete all your properties and data.
faq.howToEditProperty: How do I edit my property listing?
faq.howToEditPropertyAnswer: Go to Profile → My Properties, select the property you want to edit, tap 'Edit', make your changes, and save.
faq.howToDeleteProperty: How do I delete a property listing?
faq.howToDeletePropertyAnswer: Go to Profile → My Properties, select the property, and tap 'Delete'. This action cannot be undone.
faq.whyPropertyNotShowing: Why isn't my property showing up?
faq.whyPropertyNotShowingAnswer: New properties may take up to 24 hours to appear. Ensure your listing is complete with all required fields and at least one photo.
faq.isListingFreeAnswer: Yes! Creating and listing properties on NestAlbania is completely free. We don't charge any listing fees.
faq.howToContactOwner: How do I contact a property owner?
faq.howToContactOwnerAnswer: View any property listing and you'll see the owner's contact information including phone number and email. You can reach out to them directly.
